text.tspan: operator
orama node recover-raft
kept node
(highest applied index)
GET /status over SSH, all nodes in parallel
(applied_index, state), 5 s each
pick max applied index,
ties to the lowest host string;
print all, ask 'yes' (unless --force)

g.text: phase 1: systemctl stop orama-node on ALL nodes

text.tspan: wait until no orama-node or rqlited
process runs (60 s, poll 3 s); abort if not
phase 2: as orama: rm recovery.db*, write raft/peers.json
(one voter: its id and address), keep raft.db,
write raft-adv-addr and cluster-membership.json
rqlited RecoverNode: snapshot + replay log,
recovery snapshot at last index and term
poll /status for Leader (120 s, poll 10 s),
then strong read: count(sqlite_master) greater than 0
phase 4: as orama: rm raft.db, raft/, db.sqlite*,
snapshots, discovery-peers.json;
write cluster-membership.json naming the kept node
phase 5: start one node at a time; wait for Follower
(180 s, poll 10 s); each pulls a full snapshot

g.text: phase 6: poll every node for Leader or Follower (180 s)
